metadata.description: Workflow and utility plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: chezmoi
plugins.description: Chezmoi-aware dotfile editing guard and expertise. Prevents direct edits to chezmoi-managed files and provides comprehensive chezmoi workflow guidance.

plugins.name: pr-stack
plugins.description: Plan and implement features as stacks of small, focused PRs using TDD with git-town branch management

plugins.name: iterm-notifs
plugins.description: iTerm2-native Claude Code notifications: custom OSC 9 banners with project name, dock attention, and per-session waiting state via OSC 1337 user variables. Pairs with an iTerm2 AutoLaunch Python script for sound, voice, and hotkey cycling.
